document.abstract: This practice describes a means for packing SMPTE metadata and data essence, encoded by the SMPTE KLV protocol, into SMPTE 291M ancillary data packets for transport. Packing of KLV encoded metadata and data essence in this practice is defined only for a 10-bit SDI component video signal interface.
